purpose: Test whether replacing the stored global embedding with the embedding recomputed from the dataset's actual selected raw source view changes the two failure outputs consistently and without quality regression.

prior_evidence_basis.b1_current_transformed_condition_refresh: opposite GT-relative directions; it does not test replacement with the raw selected source embedding

scope: Four predeclared Phase B development objects only; no Fresh B predictions, GT quality outcomes, or repair outcomes are read.

candidate_intervention.name: Selected raw source-view global embedding replacement
candidate_intervention.treatment: Replace the stored feature with the concatenated frozen vision-encoder output computed from the official selected raw source image (view 014 for reverse objects, view 000 otherwise), using the logged vision_processor unchanged.
factors_held_fixed: condition tensor and source alpha mask
geometry/depth/normal tensors and GeoTex feature tensors
target view order and six silhouette masks
VAE posterior sampling RNG and posterior inputs
source_embedding_estimation_inputs: official selected raw source RGB only

model.precision: UNet/VAE float16; encoder and GeoTex dtypes recorded at runtime
model.posterior_rng_rule: reset the same torch/CUDA seed before each paired generation

gpu.launch_condition: Launch only after a fresh resource check confirms this device is free; use idle-class I/O and low CPU priority. If it is occupied, wait without switching devices.

metrics.unit: object; average the five non-source views equally
per_view: L* SSIM versus paired cached baseline
metrics.aggregation: Report source view separately, five unseen views per object, then paired object-level means and bootstrap uncertainty; never pool pixels across objects.

numeric: at least 3/4 objects have lower unseen-view mean FG-CIEDE2000
visual: both Fig. 4 failure cases visibly improve without a new cast or edge artifact
normal and high-texture objects show no obvious detail or structure damage
advance_gate.holdout: Even if this gate passes, Fresh B remains sealed until a separate candidate lock and validation amendment are created before any holdout output or metric is opened.

stop_rule: No threshold, scale, or per-object search. If any numeric or visual gate fails, retain the negative result and do not access Fresh B outcomes.
